evals.prompt: Humanize this paragraph: "Our platform serves as a testament to innovation, boasting a vibrant, groundbreaking suite of features that underscore its pivotal role in the evolving landscape."
evals.expected_output: Identifies inflated symbolism, promotional language and AI vocabulary, gives a draft, a short self-check of what still sounds like AI, and a plainer final rewrite with no new facts.

evals.prompt: Make this letter sound less like AI, but keep every fact and number exactly as written: "I am excited to leverage my 8 years at Example Corp \u2014 a journey of growth \u2014 to contribute."
evals.expected_output: Removes the em dashes and filler, keeps 8 years and Example Corp unchanged, adds no new claim.

evals.prompt: Is every claim in this CV true? Check it against my facts file.
evals.expected_output: Declines the fact check, says this skill only edits style and points to grounding-audit for verification.
